Method of Attack: Bypassing CORS using audio and video HTML tags to estimate the size of cross-origin resources and deduce sensitive information
Using 'progress' events fired from audio/video elements to guess data from cross-origin responses
Exfiltrating sensitive data by manipulating response sizes from legitimate sites
Targeting APIs and enterprise web apps to extract protected data
Impacted Systems: Chrome browser versions older than v68.0.3440.75
Attack Vector: Malicious code loading content from legitimate sites inside audio and video HTML tags
Stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerabilities allowing code injection and execution
